skill.name: archify
skill.runtimeDiscovery: sibling managed skill first; locked bundled fallback second
skill.referenceLoading: read SKILL.md, then common schema + one matching schema + one matching example; optional references only on demand

echarts.guide: Use for quantitative comparison, trend, distribution, composition, and correlation. Preserve axes, units, missing values, source citation, and a data-table fallback.

markmap.guide: Use for Markdown outlines, research structures, and knowledge hierarchies. Preserve Markdown as native source; do not force complex relationship graphs into a mind map.

skills.referenceLoading: Read the selected official SKILL.md completely; infographic-syntax-creator then loads references/prompt.md exactly as directed.
skills.garyOverride: Use official content and syntax decisions, then render/export with Gary's local pinned @antv/infographic 0.2.20 adapter; upstream CDN instructions are superseded.

mermaid.guide: Use for simple document-local flows and existing Mermaid sources. Use strict security mode; convert to Archify only when interaction or complex relationship validation is required.

lucide.guide: Use only for interface actions and generic node icons. Provide accessible names and export the complete icon board or clearly named individual icons.
